name: statewright
description: Use your Statewright workflows in chat.

interface.longDescription: Use Statewright workflows in chat. Connect your Statewright account through OAuth to list available workflows, inspect workflow definitions, and check workflow state. Statewright supports state-machine workflows for AI-assisted development. Available tools and enforcement depend on the connected host. This plugin cannot change the selected model of a ChatGPT web conversation.

review.commerce_description: No payment or card information is required to enable functionality. Optional individual upgrades and team subscriptions are purchased on statewright.ai and processed by Stripe.

publication.release_notes: Update the display name to Statewright AI, clarify supported workflows, remove commercial language from the listing description, and specify the Developer Tools category.
